Long before Almaíso takes its full shape, there are people who already carry its spirit.
Linda is one of them.

With a background in nutrition science and years inside Europe’s leading retreat environments, she brings together worlds that rarely meet:
science and intuition
structure and flow.

At Almaíso, she is rooting the direction and creation needed to bring this vision to life.

Guided by our three pillars:
Regeneration, Connection, and Joy.
She shapes the spaces, the experiences, and the retreat formats that will define what Almaíso becomes.

For Linda, food is not just nourishment.
It is medicine.

And beyond all expertise,
what defines her is her presence:
open, warm, and full of life,
someone who makes others feel at ease
even in the most intense moments.

We are grateful to have her on this journey. 🌿

Guiada por nuestros tres pilares:
Regeneración, Conexión y Alegría. Da forma a los espacios, las experiencias y los formatos de retiro que definirán lo que Almaíso llegará a ser.

Para Linda, la comida no es solo nutrición.
Es medicina.

Y más allá de toda experiencia,

abierta, cálida y llena de vida. 
Alguien que hace sentir a todos en calma
incluso en los momentos más intensos.

Estamos agradecidos de tenerla en este camino. 🌿

Scott is the kind of person who turns ideas into something real.

A path.
A garden bed.
A tree finding its place.
A structure built by hand.

With a background in fine arts, carpentry, landscaping and years of creating his own projects, he brings imagination, skill and a hands-on spirit to Almaíso.

Today, much of his care goes into Almaíso Verde, where he plants, builds and helps create the conditions for life to grow.

What makes Scott’s presence so special is not only what he creates, but the energy he brings while creating it.

Humour.
Attention.
Lightness.
A simple joy in being close to the land.

He reminds us that reconnecting with nature does not need to be complicated. Sometimes it begins with noticing what is already growing, laughing together and caring for one small thing at a time.

We feel grateful to have Scott guiding this green part of Almaíso.

Because he does not only help plants grow.

He helps this vision take root.

Thank you, Scott, for caring for Almaíso Verde with so much patience, love and joy.

The mountain has been here longer than any of us.

For the Guanches, the first people of this island,
it was not Teide.
It was Echeyde.
A fire underneath the world.
A breath from somewhere older.

They did not climb it.
They listened to it.
They believed something ancient lived inside,
that the mountain was alive.

From Almaíso, we wake to it.
The light shifting on its slopes.
The clouds gathering and parting at its feet.

We do not call it a view.
We call it a presence.

Older than us.
Older than this house.
Older than the names we give the land.

Something to remember when the days move too fast.
The mountain holds. The mountain stays.

And we are here, for a moment, beside it. 🌿

La montaña ha estado aquí más tiempo que cualquiera de nosotros.

Para los Guanches, los primeros habitantes de esta isla,
no era Teide.
Era Echeyde.
Un fuego debajo del mundo.
Un aliento de algún lugar más antiguo.

No la escalaban.
La escuchaban.
Creían que algo ancestral vivía dentro,
que la montaña estaba viva.

Desde Almaíso, despertamos con ella.
La luz cambiando sobre sus laderas.
Las nubes reuniéndose y separándose a sus pies.

No la llamamos vista.
La llamamos presencia.

Más antigua que nosotros.
Más antigua que esta casa.
Más antigua que los nombres que le damos a la tierra.

Algo para recordar cuando los días pasan demasiado rápido.
La montaña sostiene. La montaña permanece.

Y aquí estamos, por un momento, a su lado. 🌿

This is what a day in our teacher training looks like in @almaiso.tenerife 🇮🇨
And honestly, words don’t quite do it justice.

Jesper walks you through the rhythm of it in his own words: the morning practice, the study sessions, the moments in between where the real learning happens.

But what you’ll see is the part we love most. 
People sweating through sequences and then bursting out laughing. 
A sound bath that made the whole room go still. 
A tiny cat who showed up and never really left. 
The volcano in the background, always there. Adjustments that land exactly when you need them. And a closing ceremony that nobody wanted to end. 💗

This was our YTT community last November in Tenerife. We miss them already. 🌞
